news.headline: Infosys expands generative AI enterprise platform partnership
news.summary: Infosys announced an expanded collaboration with major enterprise cloud providers to deploy generative artificial intelligence solutions across global client accounts.

news.headline: Infosys reports steady volume growth in September quarter filing
news.summary: In its Q2 FY27 regulatory filing, Infosys posted steady volume growth driven by financial services and European manufacturing digital transformation programs.

news.headline: Infosys slides over 2 percent amid cautious global IT spending outlook
news.summary: Infosys shares dropped 2.2% in Monday trading as global tech spending concerns and client budget reviews weighed on the IT sector.

news.headline: TCS secures multi-year digital transformation deal with UK insurer
news.summary: Tata Consultancy Services signed a five-year contract to modernize legacy core platforms and migrate mainframe workloads for a prominent UK insurer.

news.headline: TCS declares interim dividend alongside second quarter results
news.summary: The board of Tata Consultancy Services declared an interim dividend of ₹10 per equity share alongside its second-quarter performance update.

news.headline: TCS expands research footprint with new engineering lab in Munich
news.summary: TCS inaugurated an advanced engineering and automotive software research center in Munich to support European original equipment manufacturers.

news.headline: HDFC Bank opens 150 new retail branches across semi-urban clusters
news.summary: HDFC Bank announced the commissioning of 150 new rural and semi-urban branch locations as part of its ongoing national branch network expansion.

news.headline: HDFC Bank reports deposit growth of 15 percent year on year
news.summary: In its quarterly business update, HDFC Bank reported aggregate deposit mobilization grew 15.1% year-on-year to reach ₹24.2 lakh crore.

news.headline: ICICI Bank expands digital lending stack with instant SME credit limits
news.summary: ICICI Bank introduced enhanced automated underwriting capabilities for small business borrowers on its InstaBIZ enterprise banking platform.

news.headline: ICICI Bank net interest margin holds steady in second quarter
news.summary: ICICI Bank reported resilient domestic loan growth and a net interest margin of 4.36% in its quarterly financial earnings release.

news.headline: ITC commissions green integrated consumer goods plant in Odisha
news.summary: ITC Limited completed construction and operational trials of an integrated packaged foods manufacturing facility powered by renewable energy.

news.headline: ITC reports steady non-cigarette FMCG margin expansion in Q2
news.summary: ITC published Q2 results highlighting 8.3% revenue growth in non-cigarette FMCG segments and steady agribusiness export volumes.

news.headline: Hindustan Unilever strengthens premium skincare distribution
news.summary: Hindustan Unilever expanded direct pharmacy and beauty salon distribution for its premium derma and hydration brands across 40 urban markets.

news.headline: HUL notes rural demand recovery in second quarter commentary
news.summary: In its Q2 earnings presentation, Hindustan Unilever highlighted gradual rural volume growth following favorable monsoon distributions across northern states.

news.headline: Tata Motors completes delivery of 500 electric buses in Bengaluru
news.summary: Tata Motors supplied 500 electric transit buses with fast-charging infrastructure to the state transport utility under the clean mobility initiative.

news.headline: Tata Motors shareholders approve demerger scheme implementation
news.summary: Tata Motors filed court-convened meeting outcomes confirming shareholder approval for separating commercial and passenger vehicle businesses.

news.headline: Reliance commissions green hydrogen pilot plant at Jamnagar complex
news.summary: Reliance Industries announced the successful commissioning of its first multi-megawatt green hydrogen production unit at Jamnagar.

news.headline: Reliance Retail adds 300 grocery and consumer electronics outlets
news.summary: Reliance Retail expanded its physical footprint by opening 300 new stores across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities during the festive quarter.

news.headline: Larsen and Toubro wins major ultra-high voltage power grid package
news.summary: L&T Construction secured an engineering, procurement and construction package valued between ₹2,500 crore and ₹5,000 crore for regional transmission lines.

news.headline: L&T order book crosses record ₹5.2 lakh crore milestone in Q2
news.summary: In its half-year performance review, Larsen & Toubro stated its consolidated order book reached a record high of ₹5,20,000 crore.

news.headline: Bharti Airtel expands fiber broadband coverage to 100 new towns
news.summary: Bharti Airtel announced the deployment of high-speed FTTH home broadband infrastructure to an additional 100 municipal locations.

news.headline: Bharti Airtel reports ARPU increases to ₹211 in Q2 results
news.summary: Bharti Airtel published second-quarter results showing average revenue per user rose to ₹211 per month alongside strong enterprise data usage.

news.headline: Sun Pharma receives US FDA approval for new specialty dermatology therapy
news.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries received marketing authorization from the US Food and Drug Administration for an innovative plaque psoriasis formulation.

news.headline: Sun Pharma completes clinical trial enrollment for immunology candidate
news.summary: Sun Pharma announced completion of patient recruitment for phase-three international clinical trials evaluating its proprietary immunology asset.

news.headline: Titan opens flagship Tanishq jewelry showroom in Singapore
news.summary: Titan Company inaugurated an international flagship retail store in central Singapore to serve Indian diaspora and regional luxury buyers.

news.headline: Titan reports strong festive season retail billing in jewelry segment
news.summary: In its pre-quarterly market release, Titan Company stated its jewelry division recorded double-digit buyer footfall growth during Diwali weeks.
